snippet.title: Magtiles  - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A chill and relaxing puzzle games about moving tiles. Play at your own pace, listen to chill lo-fi music, and have a good simple time.

Wishlist now on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275650/Magtiles/

Magtiles is a simple puzzle game about moving tiles and reaching the goal. There's no rush, nor pressure! There's no time limit, and you can turn off the move limit while still getting your deserved achievements. Simple gameplay mechanics, and multiple ways to finish each level. Utilize various Tile Types to reach the end, or simply skip the level and try again later!

Magtiles Features

· 50 Levels

· More than 30 lo-fi and classical music tracks

· ASMR Sounds

· Multiple Tile Types to spice up the puzzles!

· Minimalistic and brightly colored design

· Play at your own pace

It's time for you to lay back and relax a bit. You deserve it.
